cues.text: Fibonacci is not a lone trick. It is one point in a universe of two-step recurrences.
Choose two coefficients and two starting values. The same machine can grow gently, explode, or oscillate.
The plotted terms make that split visible. Fibonacci and Lucas share a rule, while their seeds shift the trajectory.
Pair neighboring terms into a state. A single companion matrix now advances the whole recurrence.
Its eigenvalues are the characteristic roots. Their magnitudes usually decide which behavior dominates in the long run.
When the roots merge, the usual two-exponential form changes. A factor linear in n appears.
Coefficients choose the machine, seeds choose the start, and roots reveal the eventual motion.
